subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

I told Benny that __the die was cast,__ and there was no further escape.

options.text: the course of action ended and it couldn’t be restarted
the course of action would never begin
the course of action began and it could not be blocked
the course of action yet to start and it could be postponed

solution:
The correct answer is: "**the course of action began and it could not be blocked.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase "**the die was cast**" means that a decision or course of action has been taken and cannot be changed. (कोई निर्णय या कार्रवाई की दिशा ले ली गई है और उसे बदला नहीं जा सकता)

 
 
• **Example**: *After submitting his resignation, John knew the die was cast, and there was no reversing his decision to pursue a new career path.*
 
 
 
• The use of "**and**" in the sentence indicates that the course of action has already begun.
 
• The phrase "**no further escape**" emphasizes that there is no way to avoid the consequences of the decision made.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.
